rules.why: RSO coverage for ordinary multifamily depends on the October 1, 1978 construction or occupancy cutoff, and the date is for a later utility-increase change.
Coverage is limited to non-RSO units, so ordinary multifamily coverage depends on RSO-related building facts, and the date is for a specific nonpayment threshold change.
It applies to units covered by the RSO, whose coverage depends on building date, and the stated date is an annual relocation-assistance period.
It is an RSO security-deposit rule tied to the same building-date coverage, and the date states when interest began accruing.
The rule broadly covers rental housing accommodations without building-date or program limits, and the ordinance provisions took effect on the stated date.
